summary: Master inflation targeting strategies with our comprehensive training course. Enhance your skills and stay ahead in today's economic landscape.
lede: Inflation targeting is a monetary policy framework built around publicly announced quantitative inflation targets. For economists, monetary policy analysts and financial-market professionals, this training supports the practical work of measuring price changes, assessing output gaps and calibrating policy responses. It also covers inflation forecasting with VAR models and fan charts, alongside policy communication and balancing price stability with output stabilization.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for macroeconomic stability, monetary policy design, and financial market analysis who must navigate complex inflationary environments.
audience: Economic Policy Advisor to government finance ministries
modules: Evolution of Monetary Anchors and Inflation Targeting
Price Index Measurement and Core Inflation Dynamics
Macroeconomic Modeling: Phillips Curves and Output Gaps
Policy Rules: Calibrating the Taylor Rule Framework
Advanced Forecasting: VAR Models and Fan Charts
Strategic Communication and Forward Guidance Techniques
Policy Synthesis: The Monetary Policy Committee Simulation
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of macroeconomic principles, including the relationship between interest rates, inflation, and GDP. Familiarity with basic statistical concepts (mean, variance, regression) and experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis is required. Prior exposure to central bank operations or financial market analysis is highly recommended.
